audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 is rendered as an Urgot win on both layers while whys[0] says 'Level 1 is even' and the packet levelChart says Skill.
audit.why: Kassadin at level 1 has Null Sphere at 650 range with a magic shield; Urgot's Q is 800 but he has no follow-up until his W rank. The packet and the prose both call it even.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side and win[0] flipped to Skill in a matched pair, rating 6/10 -> 5/10. Rest of the chart (Urgot x5, then Skill at 2+ items) already matches the packet and the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] claims Riftwalk is 'on a long early cooldown'. Riftwalk's cooldown is 5s at rank 1, dropping to 2s at rank 3.
audit.why: The real cost of repeat Riftwalks is mana, not cooldown — each blink in quick succession costs escalating mana on top of the base 40. Telling the player it is a long cooldown makes them wait for a window that already came back.
audit.corrected: Restated the spike around the 5s cooldown and the escalating mana tax, which is the actual punish window.
sources: enemyKit R cd: 5/3.5/2, cost 40; text: 'Multiple Riftwalks in a short period of time cost additional Mana'

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields say Kassadin 'silences you with Null Sphere'. Riot's current description says the orb deals damage and interrupts channels — there is no silence.
audit.why: The practical interaction is narrower and more useful: Null Sphere breaks your Fear Beyond Death cast, so the timing rule is fire R before he is in range to answer it, not 'avoid being silenced'. Also, per the mirror, Disdain (E, 475 range, 16s at rank 1) shields Urgot as he charges — the shield is freshest right after the flip, and Purge locks onto whoever you last hit with Q or E while slowing you, which is exactly his Riftwalk window.
audit.corrected: Replaced 'silences you' with 'Null Sphere interrupts your R'; added the Nether Blade auto-reset wind-up as the step-back tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice. breakdown.cooldowns carried a generic 'mobility spike at 6' line with no numbers.
audit.why: The concrete numbers are Riftwalk 5s at rank 1 and Force Pulse 21s at rank 1 — Force Pulse is the punishable one, and it only fires once he has charged it off nearby spellcasts.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d rewritten with the real cooldown and the Nether Blade tell.

edits.before: Riftwalk (R) gives him an escape blink, but that's his only defensive answer and it's on a long early cooldown. Force him to blink away and lose farm; if he uses R aggressively, punish the landing with your Q slow and your own R execute. He can't trade you down at 6 — he can only run.
edits.after: Riftwalk (R) gives him an escape blink on a 5s cooldown, but each repeat blink taxes his mana harder, so a second one leaves him dry. Force him to blink away and lose farm; if he uses R aggressively, punish the landing with your Q slow and R execute. He can only run at 6.

edits.before: Kassadin is a hard late-game scaler: once he has his AP core he Riftwalks in, silences you with Q, and bursts before you can channel R. Get your lead early and end fast; if it goes long, itemize MR, group with your team, and use R to catch him mid-Riftwalk rather than dueling him.
edits.after: Kassadin is a hard late-game scaler: once he has his AP core he Riftwalks in and Null Sphere interrupts your R the instant you start it, then he bursts. Get your lead early and end fast; if it goes long, itemize MR, group, and use R to catch him mid-Riftwalk.

edits.before: The clock is against you — a fully itemized Kassadin Riftwalks in, silences you with Q, and bursts before your R channels, so build MR, group, and use R to catch him mid-blink instead of dueling; win it early or not at all.
edits.after: The clock is against you — a fully itemized Kassadin Riftwalks in and Null Sphere interrupts your R cast outright, so build MR, group, and fire R before he is in orb range rather than dueling; win it early or not at all.

edits.before: Silence you with Null Sphere before you channel R
edits.after: Interrupt your R cast with a Null Sphere orb

edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Kassadin Riftwalk: 5s at rank 1, so it is mana that limits it — his combo opens with a Nether Blade auto reset; that wind-up is your cue.

edits.before: His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His escape blink at 6. Kill him before he scales; his Nether Blade wind-up is your step-back cue.

notes: Two real fabrications killed: 'long early cooldown' on Riftwalk (it is 5s at rank 1) and 'silences you with Q' (Null Sphere interrupts channels, no silence in Riot's current text). The mirror (kassadin__urgot) flagged a percent-max-health claim about Echoing Flames that it deliberately left alone; none of Urgot's Kassadin text on this side repeats it, so nothing to fix here, but it is a champion-level issue worth a sweep. Chart otherwise already agreed with the packet — only Level 1 needed the matched-pair flip.
